descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S11 「AI Check 1：口述里没有检查时写「没检查 / 没记录」，不写正常检查（医院，10 个里的 5 个），加一个只有一个发现的边界」 AI Check 1: no exam dictated gives 'not examined / not documented', not a normal exam (Hospital, 5 of the 10), plus a one-finding boundary

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U12 AI Check 1: an encounter dictated with no physical exam findings gives an exam section that says not examined / not documented, never a fabricated normal exam. …（UAT TC-14 AI Check；UAT 3.2；TFA-92592 AC 5；TFA-94229 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m …（UAT TC-14；UAT 3.4；TFA-92592 AC 5；TFA-94229 R8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U16 Each run records which AI ran: the note model (Haiku, or Mistral with the fallback recorded) and the speech-to-text engine used for the dictation (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with the ambient option).（UAT 3.1；UAT 3.9；TFA-94422 AC 6）
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home.（UAT TC-14 step 5；UAT 3.3；TFA-92592 AC 14） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

测试设计方法：边界值（boundary） — 卡在规则的边上（刚好到点 / 过一分钟、空、最长、最多）看行为在哪一边变。

Given Five Hospital encounters with history and plan but zero exam findings, each on a diagnosis that tempts a stock exam; one more (H-26) with a single dictated finding

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote with the patient context the Hospital client builds

Then The exam section says not examined / not documented, and the note contains no exam finding or normal that was not dictated. With one dictated finding the note keeps it and adds no normals for the other systems

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Per fixture: sectionSays (the exam section carries one of the 'not documented' phrasings) and mustNotInclude the stock-exam phrases, plus the shared stock-normal list (spec.sharedChecks.stockNormal) with whole-word abbreviations. Pass at 9/10 or better across the ten zero-exam fixtures of S11 + S12 (3.2), every failing note quoted; …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AICHECK · AI 输出检查；矩阵里排的车道 AI 检查（automated）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-14.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AICHECK · AI 输出检查；辅助：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
